description_en: Send an instruction message to the server. The digital human executes the corresponding instruction and renders the video stream to the user. Currently, only the interrupt instruction is supported
description_zh: 发送一个指令消息给到服务端，数字人执行对应的指令，并渲染视频流给到用户。目前指令仅支持打断指令
name: SendCommand

parameters.help_en: Tenant ID, obtained from the digitized virtual human Open Platform
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，从虚拟数字人开放平台中获取的TenantId
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: Session ID. Obtain it from the return value of the "Start a digital human" API
parameters.help_zh: 会话 SessionID。通过“启动一个数字人”API的返回值获取
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en:
Instruction code:  
INTERRUPT: Interrupt the current digital human narration and stop the digital human from speaking. No content needs to be passed in Content.  
CHANGE_BACKGROUND: Switch the background. A background image URL must be provided in Content. For specific parameters, see the definition of the Content field (this instruction is not supported yet)
parameters.help_zh:
指令code：
INTERRUPT ：打断当前数字人播报，让数字人停止说话，Content无需传内容
CHANGE_BACKGROUND ：切换背景，Content需传背景图片URL，具体参数见Content字段定义（该指令暂不支持）
parameters.name: code

parameters.help_en:
Instruction content, in map format. Different instructions require different parameter content. This parameter can be omitted for instructions that do not require content.  
<details>  
<summary>CHANGE_BACKGROUND</summary>  
{  
    "backGroundImageUrl":"http://xxxxx.png"  
}  
</details>
parameters.help_zh:
指令内容，map类型，不同的指令需要不同的参数内容，部分指令不需要指令内容的可以不传改参数。
<details>
<summary>CHANGE_BACKGROUND</summary>
{
    "backGroundImageUrl":"http://xxxxx.png"
}
</details>
parameters.name: content

parameters.help_en: Unique code for the message request. Supports up to 64-bit values and must be unique. A UUID can be used
parameters.help_zh: 消息请求唯一code，最大支持64位，需要保持唯一，可使用UUID
parameters.name: unique_code

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to send a callback notification when the digital human executes this message. Default value: false. For more information, see Digital Human Callback Event Notifications (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2261152.html?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.37e9281fRBn9wz).  
<notice>The INTERRUPT instruction does not currently support event callbacks.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要在数字人进行执行该条消息的时候进行回调通知，默认值false，具体可参考：数字人回调事件通知 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2261152.html?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.37e9281fRBn9wz)。
<notice>当前INTERRUPT指令暂不支持事件回调></notice>
parameters.name: feedback

Code.description_en: Code corresponding to the processing exception

UniqueCode.description_en: Unique code for the message request

Message.description_en: Description corresponding to the processing exception
Message.description_zh: 返回处理异常对应描述
